Manifesto · 001

Rooted in stone.
Warmed by fire.

Cavern was carved from stone, soul and Mesopotamian pride. We didn’t follow trends — we followed our roots. Every arch, every low light, every cup of tea is an invitation to slow down and share a table.

Breakfast daily · Dining from 1 PM · Café · Restaurant · Late-night lounge

Our story · 002

A shared table
in Erbil.

We built Cavern for the long conversations — the ones that start over breakfast and end somewhere past midnight. Warm plaster, raw stone, low amber light and a kitchen that never rushes you.

Walk in for a flat white at nine. Stay for a slow dinner from one o’clock. Come back on a Wednesday for candlelight and flowers.
